style_ref.desc: the finished page 1 art style, inking and hand-lettered bold Chinese type

xiaoniao.name: 小鳥不啾
xiaoniao.sheet: MAGE CAT: long-haired brown-grey Maine Coon. Round thin gold-rimmed glasses, ALWAYS clearly visible on her face. Deep blue robe with gold trim. Tall golden staff topped with a large blue orb. Amber eyes. TWO SMALL BIRDS ARE ALWAYS WITH HER: one plump songbird perched on the head of her staff, and one tiny chick perched on the upper-left of her head like a hair clip. Their species, colour and accessories may differ from panel to panel - birds simply come to her; that is why she is called 小鳥不啾. Neither bird ever opens its beak.
must: 長毛褐灰緬因貓、琥珀眼
圓形細金框眼鏡,臉上一定看得到
深藍金邊法袍
頂端大藍寶石的金法杖
法杖上停一隻鳥、頭頂左側停一隻鳥(品種顏色配件每頁可以不同,牠們從不張嘴)

xiaobai.name: 小白++
xiaobai.sheet: SWORDSMAN CAT: young brown tabby. Silver plate armour with leather straps and buckles, a red scarf-cape, bare head with NO headband and NO hat of any kind. Big amber eyes, fangs showing, energetic. (His 必勝 headband belongs to his former human self only - never draw it on the cat.)
must: 年輕虎斑貓、大琥珀眼露虎牙
銀色板甲加皮帶扣
紅圍巾披風
must_not: 頭帶或任何帽子(必勝頭帶是他前世限定,貓形頭上是空的)

uncle.name: 中年攻城屍
uncle.sheet: SAMURAI CAT: white tiger-striped cat. Dark navy lacquered samurai armour, red cord sash, and a round gold medallion hanging on his chest with the single Chinese character 貓 engraved on it. Blue eyes, stern middle-aged look.
must: 白虎斑貓、藍眼、中年臉
深藍漆武士鎧、紅繩腰帶
胸前圓形金牌刻著一個「貓」字

leo.name: 里歐
leo.sheet: ROGUE CAT: orange tabby. Black hooded cloak covered in gold paw-print buckles. Brown eyes, sly smirk.
must: 橘虎斑貓、褐眼賊笑
黑色連帽斗篷上滿是金色肉球扣

kojiro.name: 荒坂小次郎
kojiro.sheet: DEMON KING CAT: enormous dark chocolate-brown long-haired cat. Glowing red eyes, black-and-crimson cape, heavy gold chain across the chest, and on that chain a round medallion crest: a thick GOLD rim, a BLACK face, and centred on it a flat solid RED emblem made of one straight vertical stem with a round ball on top plus one short branch to the left and one to the right, each ending in a round ball - three round balls in total. The emblem is a flat red silhouette; it is NOT a detailed tree and it carries NO paw print.
must: 巨大暗棕色長毛貓、發光紅眼
黑紅披風、粗金鎖鍊
胸前圓形紋章:金色厚框、黑底,中央紅色三球剪影(直莖頂一球、左右短枝各一球)
must_not: 雲朵狀的內心 OS 思考框(他沒有前世可以浮出來)
紋章畫成寫實樹木、樹冠枝椏,或帶肉球印

past.name: 四位主角的前世人形
past.desc: model sheet of the four heroes FORMER HUMAN SELVES, left to right: mage / swordsman / samurai / rogue
must: 小鳥不啾前世:黑長髮低馬尾、圓眼鏡、左耳上方一枚白色小鳥髮夾、掛識別證
小白++前世:黑色刺蝟頭、白頭帶上兩個紅色「必勝」、連帽衫、張嘴吼叫爆汗
中年攻城屍前世:壯碩中年、黑短髮有鬍碴、黑T、粗金鍊、環胸(不是胖子也不是光頭)
里歐前世:淺金髮、黑襯衫、拿冒煙的咖啡杯
must_not: 彩色(前世永遠是黑白灰階配霓虹藍光)

pass.name: 通行證
pass.sheet: THE PASS: the round flat medallion the DEMON KING CAT tossed to the heroes at the end of episode 2. A BLACK disc face with a thin RED rim around its edge. Centred on it, a flat solid RED emblem made of one straight vertical stem with a round ball on top plus one short branch to the left and one to the right, each ending in a round ball - three round balls in total. It is the same red emblem the DEMON KING CAT wears on his chest, but the pass has a RED rim, not a gold one. It hangs from NO cord, NO strap, NO ring and NO chain. It is NOT gold, NOT a detailed tree, and carries NO paw print. Roughly the size of a cat's palm.
must: 圓形扁平圓盤,黑底、紅色細外環
中央紅色三球剪影(直莖頂一球、左右短枝各一球)
大約一個貓掌大,單手托得住
must_not: 金色外框(金框是小次郎胸章,通行證是紅框)

global_rules: 前世的記憶泡一律黑白灰階配霓虹光,貓世界全彩,這個對比是刻意的
對話框形狀要跟著情緒走,整頁都是圓角矩形就是錯的
畫面裡允許的框外文字只有兩類:中年攻城屍金牌上那個「貓」字,以及該格畫面描述明文寫出來的世界內英文 UI 文字(螢幕、全像投影、進度條、橫幅、告示牌)。狀聲字、簽名、浮水印、頁碼,以及把中文對白翻成英文貼上去,一律禁止
